nom: Naturium Fermented Camellia Creamy Cleansing Oil

avis.texte: Very disappointed, very light and dissolved fast when water is added, wanted to like it but I feel like I bought water.

I have been trying a number of cleansing balms and oils over the past year or so and have loved the ELF cleansing balm the most until trying this product. It removed all my makeup and sunscreen, doesn't irritate my eyes, and isn't over-fragranced. My only critique is that it doesn't come in a jumbo size. Give it a try, I think you will love it too.

Removing makeup and double cleansing at the end of the day is no longer a chore thanks to this cleansing oil gel! After trying many varieties, this one has secured holy grail status for me. It removes makeup quickly without burning my eyes, it rinses all the way off, and it has no nasty smell. Though I love Naturium, some of their fragrance free products have a strong chemical smell. In this one, you can barely make out the floral scent of the camellia, and it's otherwise unscented. My skin can be temperamental but I've not gotten any breakouts since using this, even with now daily makeup use. My ONLY gripe is that I wish the bottle were even bigger!
This product delivers on all claims and is amongst my favorite oil cleansers (having tried MANY on the market). Removes makeup easily, well-designed packaging, and an outstanding value.
Good value. I wanted a cleansing oil that wasn't primarily sunflower oil.

I wanted to try the bottle version, instead of scooping out the purple ginseng one. This is a good texture and my very dry skin doesn't dry out, especially with double cleansing. I don't know if it's my make-up products, but it doesn't wash out the [mineral] sunscreen well or my mascara (Essence NON-waterproof) AND TO BE CLEAR this is with double cleansing. My mascara was still present and my sunscreen was pilling than dissolving. The purple ginseng was better but I still had make-up residue

I absolutely love this jelly? The texture is so cool! How could anyone dislike this product! I apply a genourous ammount and wait for it to warm up as I massage my face. My favorite part of my night time routine! 💕🧖‍♀️

Struggling with this. The texture is fun to use and it technically does remove makeup but it leaves the most residue of any cleansing oil or balm I've tried. I always do a double cleanse when I wear makeup + spf. Even after my second cleanse with my go-to cleanser, I have residue of this oil on my face and have to then do a third cleanse. I have such sensitive and reactive skin that I can't afford to use something that won't thoroughly wash off easily. I wish I didn't wait so long to try this otherwise I would have returned it while I could have. It's the only Naturium product I've used that's disappointed me.
I like the brand, but this product was a fail for me. It does not do a good job removing eye makeup, then leaves a residue that doesn't rinse clean. It left my eyes blurry.
This cleaning oil is amazing it literally removes everything leaving my skin feeling hydrated not even oily but hydrated! It feels & smells amazing!

I am 52 years old and absolutely love this cleansing oil. It takes off Loreal Panorama mascara when nothing else would. With it being oil based it moisturizes my skin rather than drying it out. I use many of the Naturium products now and my skin is finally glowing and at my age! Love it!

i absolutely adore this oil cleanser!! it takes all my makeup off, doesn't hurt if it gets in my eyes, and works wonderfully with the naturium cleanser afterwards. also, something about the gel-to-oil consistency is so satisfying to feel change in my hands before applying to my face lol

I really wanted to like this especially since ive tried quite a naturium products, specifically their body washes. I love their body washes and kept this in mind when i bought it, I was expecting this cleanser to be just as good but boy was i wrong. i dont use any waterproof makeup products and a majority of the time i dont wear makeup but i still double cleanse regradless of whether or not i wore makeup that day. This barely took off makeup, so much would be left behind that id either have to triple wash my face or just use micellar water to get the rest off. My face never felt clean afterwards either and honesly, it felt like i had even more gunk and oils on my face than what i started with. i really wanted to like this and i continued to use it after deciding that i didnt like the product. im not sure if your skin is suppose to feel hydrated after using this or what and if thats the case, this might work if your skin is on the drier side but thats a big if.

avis.titre: Not sure if this is suitable for sensitive skin
avis.texte: It works, but not on waterproof make up and mascara. I don't see anything that its ideal for sensitive slin because my face always looked red when i washed it off.

This has to be one of my favorite oil cleansers for double cleansing. It truly does melt away your makeup and sunscreen. It also makes your face feel super soft after. Plus, its super afforable compared to other brands.

Absolutely loveeee this cleanser. Ive tried many others that would irritate my eyes and leave a weird film over my eyes after use. This one doesnt do that at all and does a great job at removing my makeup. The gel to oil transformation is also really cool, definitely recommend!!

I throughly enjoy this makeup remover. It is thick but if you work it in on dry skin and then add water to emulsify it, then it works like a charm. It's about using just enough and not too much because it will spread as you rub it in. It removes waterproof mascara, eyeliner and all. The plus is that it isn't drying.

I love naturium but this product is not my favorite. The consistency is too thick and when I rub in in between my hands it doesn't get that slick slippery feeling to easily rub on my face. It feels like a thick sticky goo that I would have to tug my skin on to rub it around.

avis.titre: Gel to oil to milk cleanser is "The Balm"
avis.texte: This cleanser feels so nice and removes all traces of makeup. A lot of brands are making these types of cleansers with an enormous price tag. I love this one for the price, the texture and the efficacy. Why would I shop anywhere else?

I love rhis formula! Its in a tube and comes out as a gel so i have full control of how much product i get. The directions did say to warm in hands dor 8-10 seconds and it woll become an oil and took off my waterproof mascara great. It did take some work but it did an amazinf job.
Consistency of honey and doesn't emulsify much. Leaves mascara behind.

I like the packaging. Texture is nice but a little too thick. Better to wipe off excess instead of washing off. You still need eye makeup remover. Would recommend over other products but not my Clinique makeup removing balm. My facial skin needs less friction.

I love most of the products of this brand, but this is definitely my least favorite. I find you have to work too hard to get the product to turn into an oil and it doesnt do that well at removing makeup compared to other cleansing oils. My face and eyes also stung for a bit after using. Defnite Pass.

Very nice texture and doesn't dry out my mature/sensitive/dry skin. Doesn't remove eye makeup as well as I'd hoped. I'm pretty minimalist and probably won't repurchase, just because it requires a second cleanse to remove all traces of mascara & eyeliner.
Favorite cleansing balm/oil! I love that I don't have to funk my hands into a tub of product. I will say the texture is a pure preference thing

There are so much better cleansing oils and melting balms in the market, whether it is more affordable brands or luxury brands. This texture did not feel like an oil, it feels more like a gel. It was really hard to melt/activate with hands which made it abrasive trying to remove makeup and it didn't even take off all the makeup. Very disappointing

for the price of this product i would say its not worth it. many oil cleansers ive tried remove makeup just as well and emulsify much better than this product. the gel takes a lot of work to melt it down to an oil in your hands which just makes the whole process that much more effortful and time consuming

avis.titre: I feel like I have to use so much...
avis.texte: I really don't like the feel of this product. I can barely feel anything on my face. It feels like I have to use so much of it to feel anything. Perhaps that's just a preference of mine but if I'm removing makeup or SPF, I want to feel the product I'm using working. I don't get that with this.
I love this cleanser! It is not as messy as jar balms and better for travel I think. It's amazing at dissolving and my skin - 53 y o and very dry - loves this.
This is a great product! It really cuts through the eye makeup, gently, without tugging and pulling cotton pads and liquid remover. A new fave.
I use this as my first cleanse to remove make up and debris. It does a great job taking off mascara and leaves the skin feeling soft and not stripped.
I've only had for a couple of weeks. I use once a week maybe twice. Skin feels very soft and clean. It's nice to know it's removing spf and all the day's makeup.
I like this better than the cleansing balm. This doesn't irritate my eyes. I feel like it does a good job of breaking down my sunscreen and any makeup that I have on.
I like this Cleansing Oil better than the cleansing balms I have used. Rinses clean and leaves my face soft.
It's just okay. I've had better oil based cleansers. I don't like that when I use this my face still feels oily until I use a second cleanser.
10 out of 10 to clean your face specially to melt away makeup.
a daily favorite. great texture and takes off my makeup including mascara.
This cleansing oil can't remove even the most basic, transferable mascara. I've never been more dissatisfied with a cleansing oil. I would not recommend this to anyone.

avis.titre: Another one of my naturium holy grails
avis.texte: I love this cleansing balm. I use it every single day twice a day for 3 months now. I had to buy another one. I don't want to be without this product. It's the perfect & effective first cleanse. Leaves my face soft, clean & hydrated.

avis.titre: Very thick and hard to wash off
avis.texte: I really, really wanted this to work but it's hard to soften it and then once you emulisfy it's so hard to wash off. It left a greasy film and I'm just not sold.

Went out of my way to review because this does not take off makeup! I normally use Korean cleansing oils as a first cleanse, but picked this up when I ran out of my normal oil cleanser. This does not emulsify well with water and even after double cleansing there is still makeup smeared on my face cloth. Just fine for what it is.

I saw all of the great reviews for this cleanser and I just don't get it. I use oil cleansers every day so I know they emulsify with water, but this one doesn't even if I rub for minutes! I'll just repurpose it as a shaving oil since it leaves a residue that might be moisturizing on my legs.

When it comes out, it's quite thick. It takes a moment to warm in between your hands so you can apply to your face. It does warm and melt and feels great when gliding on face, even great for a little facial massage. But during the emulsifying stage, it doesn't feel like it emulsifies fully, and that thick formulation seems to work against it. After rinsing and wet rubbing, it leaves a not-quite-clean feeling. And a micellar water on cotton pad confirms it doesn't perform well as a first cleanser.
I wish this spread easier but I will definitely use it until it's gone

I loooove this cleansing oil! Gets everything off and rinses clean! I hated the ginseng cleansing balm bc of the film it left on my face. So I was super happy when I tried this. I use this + enzyme cleanser at night. Great combo
This melts down super quick into a nice oil. It removes everything except my mascara which is my only complaint. It does leave my skin super soft as the first cleanse.

avis.titre: Creamy cleansing oil, a little too thick
avis.texte: I would like this to be more of a oil not a vaseline consistency it's much too thick for my liking

I started using this cleanser about 6 months ago and have never looked back. I love the fact that even after rinsing it leaves my skin feeling soft and moisturized. It is easy on the eyes with no burning. Perfect cleanser!
It just doesn't work. You require a copious amount of it, and it still doesn't remove even simple mascara.

avis.titre: As good as the Pink Drink
avis.texte: Fantastic moisturizing cleanser, face feels clean and hydrated.

This cleansing oil is amazing! It glides beautifully over the skin and removes all of my makeup with ease! A little product goes a long way! This product is so enjoyable to use. I love that it's in a squeeze tube compared to a cleansing balm that takes a little more effort to use
Love this! So far the only cleansing oil that doesn't irritate my skin/cause my rosacea to flare up!

I have used several jelly oil and just pure oil cleansers for my first step of cleansing off sunscreen and/ or makeup off my skin. But none leave the skin feeling so soft and actually refreshed without the greasy finish that makes you want to wash it off with a 2nd cleanser immediately. This can now work perfectly as a morning cleanser for me now as well with how this feels after rinsing off with water - so great value as I don't feel this strips the skin at all while effortlessly cleaning off waterproof makeup.

You have to use a quite a bit of oil in order for it really be effective, and even so, it never really got all my eye makeup off (regular eye makeup, not waterproof). Whenever I used this as my first cleanse, followed up with a gel cleanser, I would still have mascara residue.

For my double cleanse, I typically use a balm cleanser because I like how it melts into an oil without being too greasy. I ran out of my balm cleanser and decided to try the Fermented Camellia Creamy Cleansing Oil. The product comes out like a firm jelly consistency and turns into a nice oil cleanser without being too heavy. Like other reviews have stated, I did find that it takes an extra few seconds to go from that "firm" consistency to a smooth, pliable oil cleanse. I'm willing to overlook because it has greatly reduced the redness on my cheeks from the rosacea. My skin feels hydrated and well prepped for the next part my double cleanse. How I use this product: I only use it at night as the first part of the double cleanse. Skin type: I have dry, sensitive skin and have to deal with psoriasis and rosacea.
I didn't love this like I thought I might. It's fine. But I don't get the same joy as I get from the balm which I adore. I thought I'd try something new for my first cleanse. But it's just ok.

WOW WOW WOW I really enjoy using this product, it makes me want to wear makeup just so I can use this product to wash it off! I absolutely love how it comes out as a gel then turns into the oil once smoothed on the skin. It really helps me use not too much and waste the product.

avis.titre: Wish I was a fan of this product
avis.texte: Sadly I did not like this double cleanser. :( It left an oily feel even after emulsifying and follow up with 2nd cleanser. Love the bottle, look, gel, but the oily feel after is a bummer.
The weight is perfect — it feels luxurious without being heavy. However, it is more of a gel than a cleansing oil.
It doesn't rinse off, it leaves an oily film, not good removing eye shadows and mascara
It was ok. Honestly, not hydrating enough. And, that's a bit odd considering the medium.
Love the texture of this lovely! Emulsifies with water, and takes of makeup and sunscreen great!

I liked this but didn't love it. I like my Elemis skin cleanser more but I think this is good. Don't get me wrong it gets the job done I just felt like I had to work harder and it kind of burned my eyes.
I always repurchase this cleansing oil gel! It's part of my double cleansing routine and melts away the makeup gently including my waterproof mascara. Super travel friendly too!

I usually use coconut oil as a first cleanser but wanted to try this because I love fermentation as an ingredient. It's awesome. It starts a gel and melts into an oil and it really softens the skin but doesn't feel greasy.
It does not foam at all, not soft on the skin... I have tried better products... it's not bad but it does not work for me.

I am not new to oil cleansers and I have been double cleansing for several years. I am generally not that picky when it comes to oil cleansers - I just need them to take off sunscreen/makeup and *mostly* wash off. A bit of residue has never bothered me since I always follow up with a water-based cleanser. This however, doesn't emulsify with water at all, nor does it even remotely wash off. My second cleanse wasn't able to get rid of the residue, and after using it for a few days my skin became super sensitized (i.e. stung when I put on my normal moisturizer). I wasn't using any other new products and as soon as I stopped using this my sensitivity stopped, and I do not have sensitive skin. It was so bad that I'm wondering if I got a bad batch because this product is so well loved by others, and I generally don't ever get sensitive from new products. I used it for 5 days and basically have a full bottle left that I don't feel comfortable giving to friends/family to try out. I have liked other products from this brand, but this was awful.

Wow, can't even put into words just how much I love this cleanser - such a unique yet effective product. The way it changes from a gel to oil is amazing. It removes all of my makeup and my skin feels so soft after rinsing - just incredible. For reference, I have dry skin and I'm in my late 60's, but I wear a full face of sunscreen and makeup everyday.

avis.titre: This changed my mind on cleansing oils!
avis.texte: In love with this cleansing balm! I follow up with the Niacinamide Cleanser Gelee and have noticed a difference in my skin. The cleansing oil doesn't dry out and strip my skin and feels so smooth going on. I am a believer!

I love a nice oil cleanse. This one however does not rinse off completely. Even after my second wash, I need a toner to remove lastt traces of it. I would however suggest it for someone with extremely dry skin.
It feels luxurious going on, cleans well and I have mature oily but dry skin and this feels amazing! Oily skin? Try it!

Love the ginseng cleansing balm was curious to see how this would compare… it comes skit gel like consistency and you have to melt it in your palm before applying… didnt give me that smooth buttery application the ginseng balm gives… probably won't repurchase but I'm glad I tried it cause I love Susan yara and support her products

avis.titre: I'm going to say it's a good product but too light
avis.texte: As much as I like the product, I've had better. You need to use a large amount to get the results you want. I didn't realize how small the tube actually is. It gets the job done but you're not going to get many uses. I try not to use it too often so it will last long I
It is everything I enjoy in a cleanser Im in love with this Naturium's entire line I wish these products would be available in Canada
Get off the days dirt with ease thumbs sunscreen make up without overdrive without overthrowing my skin and I have oily skin

avis.titre: Love the consistency and great for my 1st cleans
avis.texte: I used two bottles of this already it is so great for my first cleanse before I use the niacinimide gelee cleanser. It's gentle and doesn't sting my eyes but takes all my makeup and sunscreen off. Very cool jelly oil consistency!

The texture is amazing, but this does not wash off my mascara. I have to rub my eyes for so long with this product to breakdown my mascara and even when I do a complete double cleanse, I am still left with so much mascara. Price is good but the product is not a gold makeup remover unfortunately.

I was disappointed in this cleanser. It's too thick and does not melt into an oil. Because of the thick consistency, it's difficult to massage into the skin. This basically just smeared my makeup around without actually cleaning it off. I love the Naturium serums but this product was very disappointing.

I am very sad to say that I do not like this product. For some reason, mine is pure oil with no semblance of a gel-like consistency. I thought this was an isolated incident and I did something wrong, but after reading reviews, it looks like that is a common complaint. It works well to take my makeup off, but it leaves the oiliest film on my face that does not go away even after a 2nd cleanse. I wanted this to work so bad, but I do not like it!

avis.titre: Hard to wash off! Oily residuo
avis.texte: This product makes me question all other products I have been using from this brand. I made the switched from other cleansing oils to this one. I hate it! I have always "double cleansed", but this product leaves an oily residuo on my face that is hard to remove, even with double cleansing with another face wash.

I really love this cleansing oil. It's much better in my opinion than other popular gel-to-oil cleansers I've tried. It does a much better job melting down makeup than the Ordinary Squalane Cleanser. It easily dissolves makeup, sunscreen, and sebum and emulsifies beautifully (just make sure to use enough product, about a quarter size). I can either take it off with a face cloth or rinse it, while following with a second cleanse. It leaves my skin feeling soft and balanced and not stripped. I use both this and the Naturium cleansing balm. They both work equally well, but I tend to use the Camellia cleanser on lighter makeup days and the cleansing balm on heavier makeup days. I enjoy the different textures for some variety in my routine.

I love most natrium products. They're my go to brand, but this didn't work for me. There was definitely leftover makeup. I was hoping it would be a cleansing balm but in a tube, but it doesn't remove my eye makeup nearly as well. It doesn't irritate the eyes though.

I don't like the consistency - you reeeeallly have to warm it up in your hands for a while for it to become very liquid. That's why I prefer a consistency like the Bare Minerals Makeup Remover Oil. When I get ready to take my makeup off after a long day, I want something that's easy/ready for me to use. I don't want to warm it up in my hands for that long. And if you don't get it to a watery consistency, it's going to be hard to rub the product on your face gently. This is just not a recommended makeup remover oil to use. It works, but there are easier products to use that'll remove all your makeup.

Sadly, this just doesn't work well for me. The product doesn't emulsify at all, you need to use a lot for a good slip, and it just doesn't cleanse well. I've been really impressed by a lot of Naturium's products, but this is not one of them.

avis.titre: Excellent- Stick with it and you'll love it too
avis.texte: This product is fantastic. I use it in the shower before I get my hands or face wet. This allows me to properly work the oil cleanser into my skin to remove my spf and make-up. I then wet my hands, emulsify, and rinse. The cleanser leaves your skin feeling silky soft. This product does what it is intended to do, remove make-up and spf as your first cleanse. Now, I will say, this product has a learning curve (but so does any oil-based cleanser). Because the product looks like a gel, you are compelled to use it as a typical cleanser--wet your face or your hands and go to town. I did this at first and I can see that other people did this based on the comments. If you do that your skin will feel filmy and the product won't work. It is an oil-based cleanser and you have to treat it as one. Once you make the mental shift between what it looks like and what it is, it's great. My one complaint-- I would love a scent. I know that's controversial since everyone is anti-scent these days but I am among those, like Susan, who love a luxurious experience and scent is part of that. This product feels beautiful and I'd love for it to smell amazing too (it smells like nothing, completely neutral).

avis.titre: I had high hopes for this…
avis.texte: It's not not my fave Naturium product. It feels really nice applying to a dry face, however, when it's time to rinse, it leaves a super oily residue even after adjusting the amount of product being used.

avis.titre: Runny and not gel like at all
avis.texte: I am obsessed with Naturium products and recommend the brand to friends all the time. Unfortunately, this cleanser is the one product I absolutely do not like. It says it's creamy and that it's a gel oil. I do not think it is either of those things. It's so runny that I literally have to race to close the tube because it runs out so fast I get way too much product every time. And it feels like a straight oil on my skin. It does not emulsify and is not anywhere near creamy at all. It's just oily and it takes me a couple tries to get all the product off my face. I always double cleanse but with this I feel like I have to triple cleanse.

My first review on this product I didn't have a lot to say, hence the 4 stars given at that time. Now that I have actually used it…this is sooo good for breaking down dirt, makeup, and sunscreen. I love the way my skin feels afterwards. Highly recommended.
It does remove my makeup but it balls up my mascara instead of melting it. I would prefer it melted it. But it does work!

I like everything about the product. The fact that it is in a tube helps control the product. The oil is more of a gel so there is minimal mess. It is okay to break down light makeup but you need to follow up with a second clease.

I never write reviews. Ever. I had really high hopes for this product, but every time I use it theres an oily film leftover after I rinse. I know my skincare and I wanted to test out other cleansing oils/balms. I'm Korean and I've been double cleansing since the beginning of time. I even tried to double cleanse with a silicone face brush after to help break up the oil, but after my second cleanse I have remnants of eyeliner around my eyes that I can't even wipe away. Sad this didn't work out and now I have a whole bottle of product I can't even use on other parts of my body. Just a big waste.
Beautiful addition to my cleansing routine. I use this on my makeup face prior to my niacinamide cleansing gelee. Soothing and does a great job breaking down my makeup.

I read a few reviews pointing that this cleanser leaves a residue, and it's kind of true, but I've tried others brands and most of cleansing oils leaves a residue, it's a first step, i use as second step the mixed greens one and have no problem, expected a little more emulsion of this camellia oil, but for price point it's ok.

This precleanser is calming and gentle for makeup removal or irritated skin. It feels luxurious like a facial pre-cleanse does, so it was enjoyable but it does leave a film. I used some toner before my second cleanse to get any excess off and there was still some foundation coming off my skin, so make sure you use enough product evenly across your face and rinse it off really well. This fid not dry out my skin and my skin became really smooth when i followed this with the fermented rice exfoliating cleanser.

I was a little nervous that because this was a gel texture that it would be pore-clogging but this is the exact opposite. The texture of my skin has softened and since this is in a tube, it's easier than scooping out of a jar. I just wish it came in Jumbo!

I had such high hopes for this cleansing oil. The technology behind this product is just so innovative. However, this product does not remove makeup anywhere near as well as my Caudalie cleansing oil. It also leaves a film on the skin that I am not a fan of. Very sad to say that I was disappointed by this product
I did not like this cleaners. It didn't wash off as well as the newer cleaning balm
It does work okay as a makeup removing balm to use prior to face wash, but nothing spectacular outside of that. Plenty of other products that do the same thing for much less $.
This is a nice basic gel to oil that works as a first cleanse and doesn't sting the eyesz
I really enjoy this oil. My only area of improvement is that it doesn't always get my eye make up off enough. I have to really work it. Other than that it's amazing

I was very excited about this cleansing oil! I love everything else. While it does take of the make up very well, I find it very difficult to wash off my face. I don't think it emulsifies well and it leaves an oily residue. I would not buy this again, unfortunately.
Does not take off my eye makeup. Not sure if the double cleanse with this and the green cleanser is working.

I love everything about it. The texture, the viscosity, the results! I have a ton of sebaceous filaments on my nose and it's doing a great job at cleaning them out. I did wish it came in a bigger size!!

This is the best oil cleanser I have ever used. For reference, I am 41 so I can say I've had my fair share of trial and error on both drugstore and high end skincare. I've struggled with acne all my life and still get some from time to time. I have combination skin but becoming drier as I get older. thought I'd never be able to use an oil cleanser as most balms and oil cleansers have broke me out, or felt as if a film was leftover. I figured I'd try this one as it sounded promising. I've been using daily for about a month and literally have not gotten any new clogged pores or acne bumps. I wear my foundation pretty thick and it removes it all. I love the thick consistency as you don't require too much. Once I rub in, I start to emulsify with water and ALL my foundation, powder and blush are gone. Then I used a second cleanse thereafter. I've found my holy grail makeup remover. I hope she never discontinues it. I love it.
I have been using the cleansing oil as a single wash as my very dry skin gets even dryer as it gets colder. Very happy with it!
This is the second oil cleanser I've used and by far the best consistency. Perfect for the start of a double cleanse as it will remove all the heavy stuff before your second cleanse!
Such a unique texture and experience. It doesn't completely transform into an oil, kinda remains thick, but I still like it as a first cleanse.
I love this as a face wash in the morning. My skin doesn't feel stripped or dry.
Consistency felt too thick.. Did not emulsify, even after I added water. Basically just smeared my basic maybelline mascara. I think I'll have better luck with Naturium serums.
I've enjoyed many of the products from this line, but this was a fail. I hate the texture, doesn't Wash off the face well.
Pleasantly surprised on how great this product works. Removes my make up and has my face feels smooth!

This cleansing oil isn't bad! Like I said, its okay. I wish it emulsified more, but I think because it's an oil it's not going to emulsify as much as a cleansing balm would. I loved trying it, its great at removing makeup, and feels so so great on the skin. I really do like it, I just like a lot of emulsifying so I'll go back to my cleansing balm :)
Its a good product. For being a cleansing oil I was surprised with the gel texture
Pretty good product but doesn't get all my waterproof mascara off.

I love this oil cleanser, and I have oily skin! I use normally as a first cleanse when double cleansing but its such a unique cleanser that I can use it on its own when needing some hydration in the morning; I normally skip cleansing in the morning. I find this to be the perfect in-between of a cleansing oil and cleansing balm. Highly recommend!
